markets.rules_secondary:
Settlement uses the Pyth Network FX.USD/MXN aggregate price at the exact observation time, expressed in Mexican pesos per U.S. dollar. The price is rounded to four decimal places using round-half-up. A rounded price strictly above the strike resolves to Yes. A rounded price equal to or below the strike resolves to No. The confidence interval does not affect the outcome.

Under Rule 13.1(i), the Exchange suspends trading one minute before the observation time. Trading remains suspended while the price is verified. The Exchange will announce any resumption. If an exact observation is unavailable, the market is held for review. A substantially equivalent replacement feed published by Pyth Network may be used at the Exchange's discretion with notice to Members as provided in the contract. Revisions after expiration do not count. If an Expiration Value cannot be determined, Rule 7.1 applies.

The latest expiration is at 10:00 AM ET one week after the observation date. Expiration may move earlier under Rule 7.2 when the outcome is known.

Settlement uses the closing Pyth yield of the one-minute candlestick immediately preceding the settlement time. Other sources and stale or carried-forward values cannot substitute. Corrections, expiration and Rule 7.1 review follow the full contract rules. Kalshi is not affiliated with Pyth.
